Also known as: Theo Win; Theoretical Hold; Expected Win
Definition: The win the house is expected to earn over time: the amount wagered multiplied by the game's built-in house edge.

Also known as: Actual Hold; Net Win; Win Amount
Definition: What the house actually kept from wagering in the period: amounts wagered minus amounts paid out to players.

Also known as: Theo Variance; Actual vs Theoretical Variance; Actual vs Theo
Definition: The difference between actual win and theoretical win. Over short periods it mostly reflects luck.

Also known as: Hold Percentage; Hold Rate; Win %; Win Percentage
Definition: The share of the amount wagered (or dropped) that the house kept: win divided by wagered amount.

Also known as: House Advantage
Definition: The built-in advantage a game gives the house: the share of each wager the house is expected to keep over time.

Also known as: Return to Player; Payback %; Payback Percentage
Definition: The share of wagers a game is expected to pay back to players over time; it equals 100% minus the house edge.

Also known as: Coin In; Handle; Total Wagered; Wagers; Amount Wagered
Definition: The total amount players wagered in the period, before any winnings are deducted.
The total money players exchange for chips at a table game, used as the base for measuring table win.

Also known as: Gross Gaming Revenue; Gross Gaming Yield
Definition: Total amounts wagered minus winnings paid out to players, before bonuses, taxes and operating costs.

Also known as: Net Gaming Revenue
Definition: Gross gaming revenue after deducting items such as player bonuses, taxes and fees; the exact deductions vary by operator.

Also known as: WPUPD; Win Per Unit; Win per Machine per Day
Definition: The average win earned per gaming machine (or other gaming unit) per day.

Also known as: Average Daily Theoretical; Average Daily Theo
Definition: A player's theoretical win averaged per day of play: a measure of how valuable that player is expected to be.

Also known as: Average Revenue Per Daily Active User
Definition: Revenue divided by the number of daily active users: how much each active user brings in per day.

Also known as: Average Revenue Per Paying User
Definition: Revenue divided by the number of users who paid: how much each paying user spends on average.

Also known as: Payer Conversion Rate; Paying User Rate
Definition: The share of users who made at least one purchase.

Also known as: DAU/MAU; DAU MAU Ratio
Definition: Daily active users divided by monthly active users: how often monthly users come back during the month.

Also known as: D1 Retention; Day 7 Retention; D7 Retention; Day 30 Retention; D30 Retention
Definition: The share of new users who come back on the stated day (1, 7 or 30 days) after they first used the product.

Also known as: Average Session Length; Average Session Duration
Definition: The average time a user spends in a single visit or play session.

Also known as: Session Count
Definition: The number of separate visits or play sessions in the period.

Also known as: Slot Hold Percentage; Slot Win Percentage; Slot Hold %
Definition: The share of the money bet on slot machines that the casino keeps.

Also known as: Average Wager; Average Stake; Bet Size
Definition: The average amount a player bets each time.

Also known as: Win per Position; Win per Table Game Seat; Table Win per Seat
Definition: The casino's win divided by the number of seats available at its tables.

Also known as: Table Win per Day; Win per Table; Daily Win per Table
Definition: The casino's win from a table game divided by the number of tables and days.

Also known as: Slot Win per Day; Net Win per Machine per Day
Definition: The casino's win from slot machines divided by the number of machines and days.

Also known as: Slot Occupancy; Floor Occupancy; Machine Utilisation Gaming
Definition: The share of time that machines or seats are being played, compared with the time they are available.

Also known as: Hands per Hour; Spins per Hour; Game Speed
Definition: The number of games, hands or spins played in an hour at a table or machine.

Also known as: Theo per Day; Daily Theoretical
Definition: The expected win from a player or game in a day, based on how much was bet and the house edge.

Also known as: Player Value; Customer Worth; Player Theoretical
Definition: The value of a player to the casino, based on how much they bet and play, and what the casino expects to earn from them.

Also known as: Active Members; Carded Players; Rated Players
Definition: The number of players who played in the period and were tracked on their loyalty card or account.

Also known as: New Members; Player Registrations; New Registrations
Definition: The number of new players who joined the loyalty club or created an account in a period.

Also known as: Reinvestment; Comp Rate; Reinvestment Percentage
Definition: The value of free play, offers and comps given to players shown as a percentage of the money the casino expects to earn from them.

Also known as: Complimentary Expense; Promotional Allowances; Comps
Definition: The cost of free rooms, meals, drinks and play given to players.

Also known as: Free Play Redeemed; Promotional Credits; Free Bets
Definition: Credits given to players to play without using their own money.

Also known as: Promo Cost to Revenue; Promotional Allowance Ratio; Marketing Cost to Win
Definition: The cost of promotions shown as a percentage of the casino's win.

Also known as: Visitor Count; Gaming Visitors; Admissions
Definition: The number of people who entered the casino or venue in a period.

Also known as: ADR; Average Room Rate; Daily Rate
Definition: The average amount earned for each room that was sold per day.

Also known as: RevPAR
Definition: The room revenue divided by the number of rooms available, found by multiplying occupancy by the average daily rate.

Also known as: RevPAS; Revenue per Seat
Definition: The revenue divided by the number of seats available, used for restaurants, venues and theatres.

Also known as: Seat Utilisation; Capacity Fill
Definition: The share of available seats that were filled at an event or screening.

Also known as: Average Admission Price; Ticket Yield; Average Seat Price
Definition: The average price paid for a ticket to an event or show.

Also known as: Ticket Sales; Admissions Sold; Attendance
Definition: The number of tickets sold for events or screenings in a period.

Also known as: Box Office; Ticket Revenue; Gross Box Office
Definition: The money taken from ticket sales for films, shows or events.

Also known as: F&B Revenue; Concession Revenue; Food and Drink Sales
Definition: The revenue from food and drink sales at a venue or property.

Also known as: Spend per Head; Spend per Visitor; Per Cap
Definition: The average spending by each visitor, found by dividing total spending by the number of visitors.

Also known as: DAP; Daily Paying Users
Definition: The number of players who made a purchase in a day.

Also known as: Player LTV; Player Lifetime Value; Game LTV
Definition: The total revenue that a player is expected to bring over the whole time they play.

Also known as: Player Churn; Player Attrition; Lapsed Players
Definition: The share of players who stopped playing in a period.

Also known as: Downloads; App Installs; Game Downloads
Definition: The number of times an app or game was installed in a period.

Also known as: CPI; Install Cost; Acquisition Cost per Install
Definition: The marketing spend divided by the number of installs it produced.

Also known as: Sessions per User; Sessions per Day; Session Frequency
Definition: The average number of times each player starts the game in a day.

Also known as: Time Played; Play Time per User; Engagement Time
Definition: The total or average time that players spend in the game.

Also known as: Peak Concurrent Users; PCU; CCU
Definition: The number of players who are online at the same moment, normally shown as the peak for the day.

Also known as: IAP Revenue; In-Game Purchases; Microtransaction Revenue
Definition: The money players spend on items and upgrades bought inside the game.

Also known as: In-Game Ad Revenue; Advertising Revenue Gaming; Ad Monetisation
Definition: The money earned from showing adverts to players or viewers.

Also known as: Effective CPM; Effective Cost per Mille
Definition: The ad revenue earned for every thousand times ads were shown, used to compare how well different ad spaces earn.

Also known as: Ad Fill Rate; Ad Request Fill Rate
Definition: The share of ad requests that were filled with an ad.

Also known as: Stream Count; Plays; Streaming Plays
Definition: The number of times a song, show or video was played.

Also known as: Hours Streamed; Hours Listened
Definition: The total hours that audiences spent listening to or watching content.

Also known as: Average Audience; Average Viewers; Viewers per Episode
Definition: The average number of people who watched each programme or episode.

Also known as: Viewing Share; Share of Viewing; Ratings Share
Definition: The share of all people watching TV, or using a medium, at a time that were watching a particular channel or programme.

Also known as: Programming Cost per Hour; Cost per Hour of Content; Production Cost per Hour
Definition: The cost of making or buying content divided by the hours of content produced.

Also known as: Catalogue Size; Content Library; Titles Available
Definition: The number of titles or hours of content available on a service.

Also known as: Subscription Churn; Monthly Churn Media; Cancellations Media
Definition: The share of subscribers who cancelled in a period.

Also known as: Subscriber Gross Adds; Gross Additions; New Subscribers
Definition: The number of new subscribers who joined in a period, before cancellations are taken off.

Also known as: Net Subscriber Additions; Net Additions; Subscriber Net Adds
Definition: The number of new subscribers minus the number who left in a period.

Also known as: Freemium Conversion; Free-to-Paid Rate
Definition: The share of free users who go on to buy a paid plan.

Also known as: Room Occupancy; Occupancy Percentage; Hotel Occupancy
Definition: The share of available hotel rooms that were occupied in a period.

Also known as: Total Bets Placed; Gross Wagers; Wagering Volume
Definition: The total value of the bets placed in a period, shown before any winnings are paid out.

Also known as: Revenue Share; Gaming Tax Base; Operator Share
Definition: The share of net gaming revenue that goes to a partner, operator or tax authority under an agreement or law.
